DIRECTION A — “On Air”
Product-native. Matches the app you already built 1:1 (dark newsroom, #ff2d4d, the channel dial as hero). Ships with zero visual retooling.
Tradeoff: safe. Reads like a well-made dark AI-product page; the satire lives in the copy, not the format.

DIRECTION B — “Front Page”
The joke is the medium: your life set as the paper of record. Cream newsprint, Playfair masthead, column rules, letters to the editor. Most memorable, most on-concept.
Tradeoff: light editorial world is a hard cut from the dark app visitors land in.

DIRECTION C — “Prime Time”
Maximalist retro cable guide. The 5 channels are the star: a real TV-listings grid of your day, per-channel colors, a headline ticker. Playful, high-energy.
Tradeoff: densest to build and maintain; furthest from the current minimal app.
